components.name: Go toolchain and standard library
components.authority: Builds and runs the modular monolith; it owns no business fact independently of Control code.
components.failure: Build or startup fails closed; no alternate runtime is selected.
components.rollback: Rebuild the same source with the previously qualified exact toolchain after vulnerability review.
components.exit: Replace through a requirement-approved toolchain migration and full module requalification.

components.name: github.com/go-chi/chi/v5
components.authority: HTTP routing only; authorization, sessions, CSRF and canonical projections remain Control-owned.
components.failure: The HTTP process fails or returns bounded errors; no route becomes an authorization source.
components.rollback: Pin the previous non-vulnerable qualified release and rebuild.
components.exit: Replace the router behind net/http handlers without changing the OpenAPI contract.

components.name: github.com/jackc/pgx/v5
components.authority: PostgreSQL wire, pooling and typed scanning only; SQL transactions and business facts remain Control-owned.
components.failure: Database operations fail closed and health/readiness expose the dependency failure.
components.rollback: Pin the previous non-vulnerable qualified release and rerun PostgreSQL gates.
components.exit: Replace through the internal db adapter while preserving PostgreSQL semantics.

components.name: google.golang.org/grpc
components.authority: Bounded authenticated transport only; it owns no effect, model, plugin or Event state.
components.failure: RPCs return bounded errors/timeouts and durable operations reconcile through their owning domain.
components.rollback: Pin the previous qualified release and regenerate/test wire clients.
components.exit: Replace only behind generated Protobuf service adapters.

components.name: google.golang.org/protobuf
components.authority: Generated wire encoding only; contracts remain sourced from contracts/.
components.failure: Unknown or malformed messages are rejected before business mutation.
components.rollback: Pin the previous qualified release and regenerate golden bytes.
components.exit: Replace only with a contract-compatible Protobuf implementation.

components.name: github.com/jackc/pgpassfile
components.authority: Transitive PostgreSQL connection parsing; deployment configuration remains digest-pinned.
components.rollback: Follows the exact pgx dependency rollback.
components.exit: Removed with pgx or replaced connection configuration.

components.name: github.com/jackc/pgservicefile
components.rollback: Follows the exact pgx dependency rollback.
components.exit: Removed with pgx or disabled by explicit deployment configuration.

components.name: github.com/jackc/puddle/v2
components.authority: Bounded connection-pool mechanism only; it does not own transactions or facts.
components.failure: Pool acquisition fails within configured limits.
components.rollback: Follows the exact pgx dependency rollback.
components.exit: Replace behind the internal bounded pool adapter.

components.name: golang.org/x/crypto
components.authority: Cryptographic primitives used by qualified dependencies; policy and identity remain Control-owned.
components.failure: Authentication or connection setup fails closed.
components.rollback: Pin the previous non-vulnerable compatible release.
components.exit: Replace through the Go standard library/dependency upgrade path.

components.name: golang.org/x/net
components.authority: Network protocol support only; endpoint allowlists and deadlines remain Control-owned.
components.failure: Network operations fail within configured deadlines.
components.rollback: Pin the previous non-vulnerable compatible release.
components.exit: Replace through the Go standard library/dependency upgrade path.

components.name: golang.org/x/sync
components.authority: Concurrency primitives only; durable queues and ownership remain PostgreSQL/Control facts.
components.failure: The bounded operation fails or is cancelled; no alternate queue is created.
components.rollback: Pin the previous non-vulnerable compatible release.
components.exit: Replace with standard-library primitives behind the same bounds.

components.name: golang.org/x/sys
components.authority: Operating-system bindings only; it owns no business state.
components.failure: The affected process operation fails closed.
components.rollback: Pin the previous non-vulnerable compatible release.

components.name: golang.org/x/text
components.authority: Unicode/text support used transitively; canonical identities remain validated by Control.
components.failure: Malformed text is rejected or the request fails.
components.rollback: Pin the previous non-vulnerable compatible release.
components.exit: Replace through dependency upgrade or narrower standard-library handling.

components.name: google.golang.org/genproto/googleapis/rpc
components.failure: RPC status mapping fails closed and does not mutate canonical facts.
components.rollback: Pin the previous generated release with matching gRPC.
components.exit: Replace with contract-equivalent generated status types.

components.name: @hey-api/openapi-ts
components.authority: Build-time generation of the checked-in TypeScript SDK only; never loaded by Control runtime.
components.failure: The generation freshness gate fails and blocks module completion.
components.rollback: Restore the prior exact package lock and checked-in generated client.
components.exit: Replace with another deterministic OpenAPI generator after generated-client compatibility tests.
components.conditional_reason: Build-time only, exact package-lock pin, generated output diff and strict typecheck are mandatory.

components.name: TypeScript compiler
components.authority: Build-time typecheck of the generated SDK only; never loaded by Control runtime.
components.failure: Typecheck fails and blocks the public-contract gate.
components.rollback: Restore the prior exact compiler pin.
components.exit: Upgrade with the generated client and Web compatibility matrix.

components.name: golang builder image
components.authority: Reproducible build stage only; it is absent from the runtime image.
components.failure: OCI build fails and no image is published.
components.rollback: Use the previously qualified immutable builder digest.
components.exit: Replace with an equivalent digest-pinned Go builder after rebuild gates.

components.name: Alpine runtime image
components.authority: Minimal non-root runtime filesystem only; it owns no Control fact or secret.
components.rollback: Use the previously qualified immutable runtime digest.
components.exit: Replace with another minimal runtime through OCI startup/security requalification.
